title: Announcing Flower 1.45
summary: The Flower Team is excited to announce the release of Flower 1.45 stable 🎉
body_markdown:
The Flower team is excited to announce the release of Flower 1.45 stable, packed with new updates!


**Flower is a friendly framework for collaborative AI and data science.** It makes novel approaches such as federated learning, federated evaluation, federated analytics, and fleet learning accessible to a wide audience of researchers and engineers.


### Thanks to our contributors


We would like to give our special thanks to all the contributors who made the new version of Flower possible (in git shortlog


order):


Charles Beauville


, Chong Shen Ng


, Daniel J. Beutel


, Daniel Nata Nugraha


, Dimitris Stripelis


, Heng Pan


, Javier


, Laasya priya Bhadri


, Mohammad Naseri


### What's new?


-


**Improve the Agent runtime** ([#8549](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8549) ,[#8560](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8560) ,[#8561](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8561) ,[#8562](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8562) ,[#8564](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8564) ,[#8566](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8566) ,[#8568](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8568) ,[#8570](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8570) ,[#8572](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8572) ,[#8579](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8579) ,[#8580](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8580) ,[#8581](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8581) ,[#8583](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8583) ,[#8585](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8585) ,[#8586](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8586) ,[#8587](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8587) ,[#8589](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8589) ,[#8590](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8590) ,[#8591](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8591) ,[#8595](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8595) ,[#8597](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8597) ,[#8598](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8598) ,[#8600](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8600) ,[#8605](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8605) ,[#8606](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8606) ,[#8609](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8609) ,[#8610](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8610) ,[#8612](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8612) ,[#8614](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8614) )


Agent runs are easier to follow, and AgentApps have more flexibility in how they use Spaces. These changes lay the groundwork for more interactive Agent workflows.


-


**Apply differential privacy operations only to floating-point arrays** ([#8381](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8381) )


Differential privacy norm calculation, clipping, and noise addition now ignore non-floating model state such as BatchNorm tracking buffers, preventing casting errors and unintended changes to integer arrays.


-


**General improvements** ([#8565](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8565) ,[#8567](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8567) ,[#8569](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8569) ,[#8571](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8571) ,[#8574](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8574) ,[#8575](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8575) ,[#8578](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8578) ,[#8584](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8584) ,[#8592](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8592) ,[#8593](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8593) ,[#8599](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8599) ,[#8607](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8607) ,[#8608](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8608) ,[#8613](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8613) ,[#8621](https://github.com/flwrlabs/flower/pull/8621) )


As always, many parts of the Flower framework and quality infrastructure were improved and updated.
